decisions.reason: Its early award signal, close fit with the established yogurt range, and continued survival imply performance at or above aspiration, so we keep it.
As a highlighted flagship cheese closely tied to core capabilities, it would only be dropped after clear underperformance, for which there is no evidence, so we keep it.

This multi-variant spicy cheese line uses established cheese competences and likely earned further evaluation time, though its broader resource claim means we monitor it more closely and still keep it.
The mild creamy soft cheese is a natural extension of the existing portfolio and, absent signs of results below aspiration, remains worth keeping.
The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche of the surviving products and thus faces the highest review risk, but its continued presence and available slack still favor keeping it over dropping it.
